The Customer Success Manager serves as a strategic liaison between customers, sales, operations, sourcing, engineering, and other internal stakeholders to ensure the successful execution of system Bill of Materials (BOMs), Tier 1 network sourcing activities, and integrated sales and operations planning processes. This role is accountable for driving customer satisfaction, operational alignment, and program execution across complex data center initiatives spanning multiple global regions.
Acting as a trusted advisor and primary point of coordination, the Customer Success Manager leads cross-functional efforts to identify customer requirements, align internal resources, mitigate risks, resolve issues, and ensure delivery against business commitments. The role requires strong project and program management capabilities, customer engagement expertise, analytical problem-solving skills, and the ability to influence stakeholders across organizational boundaries without direct authority.
The Customer Success Manager owns key customer-facing processes and strategic initiatives, exercising independent judgment in managing priorities, recommending solutions, and driving execution. Success in this role depends on the ability to navigate ambiguity, coordinate multiple concurrent programs, and balance customer needs with operational and business objectives.  This position is an individual contributor role and does not include formal people management responsibilities. The title "Manager" reflects accountability for managing programs, processes, customer relationships, and strategic initiatives rather than supervising employees.  As an experienced professional and subject matter expert, the Customer Success Manager provides leadership through influence, collaboration, and execution. The role leads cross-functional teams, drives decision-making, and owns outcomes that have a significant impact on customer experience, operational performance, and business results. Internship Summary
Are you looking for an internship that provides real life experience?
Phoenix Contact's Corporate Management Team is seeking a highly analytical and business-oriented Data Science & Analytics Intern to support strategic initiatives across Product Management, Operations, Sales, and Marketing. This role is ideal for students who enjoy combining technical data skills with business problem solving to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and recommend actions.
Our Fall (Sept – Dec) interns work full time with the opportunity to continue through Spring. We strongly prefer candidates who can work onsite regularly to accelerate learning, collaboration, and business understanding.
What does a typical day look like?
Onsite Day
•	Meet with Product Management, Operations, Manufacturing, Sales, or AEP teams to understand business challenges and decision-making needs.
•	Analyze customer, product, pricing, operations, supply chain, and financial data to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
•	Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches.
•	Work directly with leadership and subject matter experts to understand product portfolios, operational processes, and customer dynamics.
•	Build dashboards, predictive models, business cases, and executive-level recommendations.
•	Present findings, risks, and recommended actions to stakeholders.
Remote day:

•	Data mining and exploration
•	Statistical analysis
•	Predictive modeling
•	Data cleansing and transformation
•	AI-assisted analytics and automation
•	Develop Power BI dashboards and self-service reporting tools.
•	Prepare executive-ready presentations and recommendations.
•	Document assumptions, methodologies, and business insights
What makes this internship unique?
Phoenix Contact is a global technology leader where interns work on real business challenges that impact customers, products, and operations. Unlike many internships focused solely on reporting, you will:
o	Work directly with Product Managers, Operations Leaders, and Executive stakeholders.
o	Gain exposure to product management, manufacturing, supply chain, sales, customer trends, and strategic planning.
o	Learn how data drives investment, pricing, portfolio, and operational decisions.
o	Apply AI, analytics, and business intelligence tools in a real enterprise environment.
o	Present insights and recommendations to leadership.
o	Build a portfolio of meaningful business analytics projects.
o	Be considered for future Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Product Analyst, Product Manager, or Business Intelligence roles.

Must-Have Qualifications
Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in:
•	Data Science
•	Analytics
•	Computer Science
•	Information Systems
•	Artificial Intelligence
•	Industrial Engineering
•	Statistics
•	Applied Mathematics
•	Business Analytics
Advanced Excel skills including Power Query, Pivot Tables, and data modeling
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, or similar BI platforms
Strong SQL and database fundamentals
Experience with Python, R, or other analytical programming languages preferred
Experience using AI productivity and analysis tools (Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)
Strong analytical problem-solving skills
Ability to translate business problems into analytical solutions
Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to business stakeholders
Intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn products, markets, and operational processes quickly

Essential Job Functions

The Director, Cabinet Efficiency is responsible for leading the Cabinet Efficiency business, with full accountability for strategic direction, operational execution, and financial performance across sales, product marketing, business development, and field service operations. The Director is responsible for identifying growth opportunities, expanding market penetration, strengthening competitive positioning, and driving customer adoption of Cabinet Efficiency solutions across key industries and market segments.  The Director plays a critical leadership role in new product introduction (NPI), market intelligence, customer engagement, and demand planning, ensuring alignment between global product strategies, regional market requirements, and commercial execution. This role translates voice-of-customer insights, market trends, application requirements, competitive intelligence, and channel feedback into actionable business strategies and product requirements that influence portfolio development and accelerate market growth. Job Summary 

 

The Regional Master Data Management (MDM) Manager II is a senior-level individual contributor responsible for the governance, quality, integrity, and strategic management of enterprise master data across regional and global business operations. As a recognized subject matter expert, the Regional Master Data Management (MDM) Manager II provides leadership and oversight for master data governance programs, ensuring data consistency, accuracy, and compliance across enterprise systems, integrations, and analytical platforms.  Working closely with business stakeholders, data stewards, IT teams, and global governance organizations, the Regional Master Data Management (MDM) Manager II drives the development and execution of data standards, quality controls, and governance practices that support operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and informed business decision-making. The Regional Master Data Management (MDM) Manager II serves as a key escalation point for complex master data challenges, leads cross-functional initiatives to improve data quality and governance maturity, and supports enterprise transformation efforts through trusted and scalable data management practices.  Although the Regional Master Data Management (MDM) Manager II does not have direct people management responsibilities, the role provides leadership through expertise, influence, and collaboration. The Regional Master Data Management (MDM) Manager II independently manages complex initiatives, mentors stakeholders on master data management best practices, and drives alignment between regional business requirements and global data strategies to maximize the value of enterprise master data. 

 

 

Responsibilities  

 

Lead the regional execution of global master data governance strategies, policies, standards, and operating procedures across assigned data domains. 

Partner with global governance teams to define, implement, and continuously improve master data standards, governance frameworks, and stewardship processes that support business objectives. 

Serve as the regional subject matter expert and authority for master data definitions, ownership models, governance practices, and system-of-record strategies. 

Ensure alignment of global and regional master data definitions, business rules, and governance requirements across enterprise transactional systems, MDM platforms, integrations, and analytical environments. 

Establish, maintain, and govern enterprise data standards, including mandatory attributes, naming conventions, reference data usage, validation criteria, deduplication rules, survivorship logic, and field-level quality controls. 

Lead the identification, analysis, root cause investigation, and resolution of complex master data quality issues impacting multiple systems, functions, and business units. 

Monitor data quality metrics, performance indicators, and compliance requirements; identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities; and drive corrective and preventive actions in partnership with business and IT stakeholders. 

Direct large-scale data remediation, cleansing, conversion, reconciliation, and mass update activities to ensure data integrity, consistency, and operational continuity across enterprise platforms. 

Provide governance reporting, audit support, compliance documentation, and data quality metrics to support regulatory, internal control, and business requirements. 

Collaborate with enterprise architecture, integration, and application teams to design, validate, optimize, and govern master data structures, interfaces, integration scenarios, and data management solutions. 

Provide functional leadership and advanced support for MDM applications, including configuration recommendations, enhancement prioritization, security controls, and process optimization. 

Lead master data readiness assessments and governance activities supporting system implementations, upgrades, acquisitions, digital transformation initiatives, automation efforts, and organizational change programs. 

Validate and approve master data requirements supporting integrations, business process improvements, technology enhancements, and enterprise transformation initiatives. 

Serve as the primary escalation point for critical cross-functional and cross-system master data issues, ensuring timely resolution, risk mitigation, and stakeholder alignment. 

Build and maintain effective partnerships with business data stewards, functional leaders, IT teams, analytics organizations, and global stakeholders to promote governance adoption, data accountability, and enterprise-wide alignment. 

Provide guidance, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to data stewards and business users on MDM tools, governance processes, and master data management best practices.

Release MRP and PRP production orders daily

SYNOPSIS: 
The Network Sales Engineer (NSE) is a specialized individual contributor within the Sales & Technical Solutions job family. This role serves as the subject matter expert (SME) on EtherWAN products, technologies, and applications across designated target markets. The NSE bridges technical expertise with customer engagement, ensuring stakeholders—both internal and external—are equipped with accurate, relevant, and actionable product knowledge.
Operating within a structured accountability framework, the NSE supports pre-sales activities, solution design, and post-sales technical guidance. The role is critical to driving customer value, enabling sales success, and enhancing product adoption through technical leadership and collaboration.

	COMPETENCY PROFILE: 
•	Global Competencies: Collaborate; Deliver Results; Develop Yourself; Drive Customer Value; Improve and Innovate; Take Ownership

RESPONSIBILITES:
•	Assist internal and external stakeholders by conducting EtherWAN product introduction and communicating EtherWAN's value proposition and applications to prospective customers.
•	Project manage field engagements alongside business development and sales resources
•	Consistent and collaborative field level engagements with prospects, partners, and customers 
•	Oodaloop ideation of technology needs from the market into the appropriate stakeholders of the organization   
•	Conduct in-person and web-based training on Networking from beginner to advanced levels. Assist in the creation of training material for both in person and online trainings via the EtherWAN Academy
•	Conduct network audits and assist customers in their network design and recommend appropriate EtherWAN products.
•	When necessary, conduct client environment simulation – recreate client networks to determine the feasibility of EtherWAN products in customer environment. 
•	Assist internal and external stakeholders with cross-referencing third-party products to EtherWAN products. 
•	Maintain knowledge of industry trends and customer needs and communicate information to appropriate internal stakeholders. 
•	Respond to customer phone calls and/or emails regarding issues related to EtherWAN products and applications 
•	Independently conduct client follow-ups, issues follow-ups, and if needed, customer meetings.  
•	Attend trade shows and industry events as needed. 
•	Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in the generation and growth of both new and existing revenue within the assigned territory by providing zero-distance application, partner, and customer support 
•	Work closely with internal and external stakeholders in generating mindshare with new and existing customers, channels, and partners.
•	Use the company CRM as the primary vehicle to log technical support cases, market and customer application information, prospects/partners/customer engagements; work across EtherWAN departments to ensure full transparency
•	Research and author application, product, and general technical and industry papers assigned
•	Perform other work-related duties as assigned 

QUALIFICATIONS:
•	Bachelor's of Science degree in Computer Science or Engineering or equivalent in experience 
•	3 years plus of customer-facing experience 
•	Understanding of differences between IT and OT networking environments
•	Direct or Channel technical sales experience preferred
•	Knowledge and understanding of the OSI Network Reference Model, Layer 2 and Layer 3 Switching, Spanning Tree Protocols (STP, RSTP, MSTP), TCP/IP, and Routing Protocols (RIP and OSPF) is required. Knowledge of wireless and cellular technology and applications is a plus. 
•	CCNA certification and/or equivalent experiences 
•	Technical certifications in networking are a plus. 
•	Candidate must be well organized, self-motivated, and capable of seeing projects through to completion. 
•	Elevated level of accountability and planning capabilities communicates with transparency and integrity. 
•	Strong written and verbal communication skills are required. 
•	Must be able to demonstrate professional presentation skills on complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences, competency as an instructor is desired
•	Proficient with CRM, Microsoft Visio, & MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
•	Subject matter expertise in vertical markets applications such as transportation (ITS/Rail and Bus transit), security (physical surveillance), energy, process automation is a plus. 
•	Able to travel 65% 
•	Demonstrates a willingness to collaborate with others, build relationships, and involve others in decision making. 
•	Demonstrates the ability to deliver results by solving or supporting others in solving problems, prioritizing tasks, and/or resources, and focusing on outcomes. 
•	Demonstrates self-awareness and the willingness to learn and grow, accept changes, and effectively adapt to changing work demands. 
•	Demonstrates the ability to drive customer value through knowledge of the business, putting effort into identifying customer needs, and delivering work to maximize the value for customers. 
•	Demonstrates a willingness to promote the value of improvement and innovation by staying ahead of trends, creating ideas and opportunities, and generating speed. 
•	Demonstrates a willingness to take ownership by making decisions, taking responsibility, and driving things forward. 


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
•	Must be able to travel via airplane for up to 6 hours
•	Must have a valid driver’s license and be able to travel via automobile for up to six hours at a time
•	Must be able to travel overnight 
•	Must be able to sit for 4 hours at a time
•	Must be able to stand for extended periods of time
•	Must be able to lift a minimum of 50 lbs. 
•	Regular and on-time attendance
